request.secret: empty for rotate; 64 lowercase hex private scalar for restore
request.expected_revision: 0..2147483646, from the separately versioned identity state

receipt.pubkey: 64 lowercase hex for completed change; null for cancellation
receipt.cancelled: boolean; true exactly for cancellation tombstones

privacy: Private/no-store. Private input remains in native secure memory or protected pending-operation storage. Never a core/drive event.

cancel.command: 32 lowercase hex; terminal cancellation, never private restore input
